place: Komala base, Alana (Dola Alane) valley, Balîsan (Balisan), Xelîfan (Khalifan), Hewlêr (Erbil)
impact: Material damage to buildings and facilities
summary: Komala of the Toilers of Kurdistan (Zehmetkêşan) said an explosive-laden Shahed drone, which it blamed on Iran's IRGC, hit one of its bases in the Alana (Dola Alane) valley of the Balîsan area at about 10 pm on 24 October, damaging buildings and facilities; it said its Peshmerga were safe and no one was hurt. Iran's Mehr news agency reported a drone operation by IRGC ground forces against the group's headquarters in Balîsan, but the IRGC did not officially claim the strike.

place: Besta region and Gabar mountain, Şirnex (Şırnak)
impact: About 3,000 steres (roughly 1,950 tonnes) of trees felled in one week
summary: Yeni Yaşam and İlke TV, citing Mezopotamya Agency, reported on 22 October that Fadıl Tay of the Şırnak Ecology Platform said about 3,000 steres (roughly 1,950 tonnes) of trees had been felled in one week in the Besta region and on Gabar mountain. Yeni Yaşam reported that village guards did the felling under the supervision of Turkish state soldiers, in the name of oil exploration, mining and a 'security dam'.
